header: An overview before a long form
subheader: The steps in order, how long each takes and what to have ready.
lead: Text about a form, not the form itself. The steps and their logic are in the TYPO3 form framework, on the page the button opens.
note: Use the same step titles as the real form. Otherwise this band will contradict the form.

steps.title: Two to eight steps
steps.text: Each row has a title, an optional duration and a sentence on what to have ready.

steps.title: The duration is the value
steps.text: Short enough to fit on one line under the title, where readers look for it.

steps.title: The list is ordered
steps.text: Screen readers announce the order. The numbers you see are only decoration.
